units.rawText: Huh? Professor? When did you get back? I guess you saw a less than mature side of myself. Hm? You found it cute? You're teasing me again, Professor... In that case, this cup of coffee is yours.

units.rawText: Back then, I kept giving myself extra work out of habit, thinking that I could endure anything. Although the truth is that I was just using the work to mask my uneasiness. It was as though I could run away from all the problems I couldn't face as long as I put my nose to the grindstone long enough...
